Skeleton

Loading placeholder with a slow shimmer. Mirror the shape of the content that will replace it.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

Skeleton

Loading state for program lists, unit search results and dashboards. Prefer it to Spinner whenever the final layout is known — it keeps the page from jumping.

<Skeleton variant="card" />
<Skeleton variant="text" lines={3} />
<Skeleton variant="circle" width={56} />
  • Match the real content shape and count; three card skeletons for a 3-up card grid.
  • Shimmer is neutral grey only — never tint it with brand purple.
  • Unmanaged by the motion setting (it is not .rse-motion-managed): when data-rse-motion is reduced, the safety net in tokens/base-runtime.css suppresses the shimmer.

Plain HTML contract

<div class="rse-skeleton rse-skeleton--text" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="rse-skeleton__line"></div>
  <div class="rse-skeleton__line"></div>
  <div class="rse-skeleton__line"></div>
</div>
<div class="rse-skeleton rse-skeleton--circle" aria-hidden="true" style="--rse-skeleton-width:56px"></div>

Variants are --text, --rect, --card, and --circle. Optional custom properties --rse-skeleton-width and --rse-skeleton-height accept CSS lengths or percentages; --rse-skeleton-radius accepts a var(--rse-radius-*) reference for non-text blocks. The last text line is shortened automatically. Announce loading in a separate status message, not on each decorative shape. React forwards the ref and native div attributes, merges className and caller style, and writes only geometry custom properties inline. The existing neutral shimmer uses themed surface/border roles and the loop duration token.

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
varianttext rect card circle—text = stacked lines; rect / card / circle = single block
widthstring | number—CSS width (default 100%, or 48px for circle)
heightstring | number—
linesnumber—Line count for variant text
radiusstring—Override border radius with a --rse-radius-* token reference

Also accepts every attribute of React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, a ref and className.

.rse-skeleton
